mapper.select: SELECT id, message_id, parent_id, nickname, content, likes, created_at FROM message_comments WHERE message_id = #{messageId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_comments (message_id, parent_id, nickname, content, likes, created_at) VALUES (#{comment.messageId}, #{comment.parentId}, #{comment.nickname}, #{comment.content}, #{comment.likes}, #{comment.createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE message_comments SET likes = likes + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
